mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, negatively affecting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals robust economic activity, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO > 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS > 3-month MA and UNRATE < 3-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, which is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS < 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong economy, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO > 6-month MA and UNRATE < 6-month MA.
